title: Help pls, I erased accidentaly some time ago my game folder :(

posts.author: olix_99
posts.body:
It's possible to open my project in rpg maker 2003 using the downloadable build of my game?
I erased the original folder accidentally and I can't recover it definitively

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
What would be download version?
If it is the installer, it is possible, just extract the LZH file with Winrar or 7-ZIP, the folder is your project.
Close RPG Maker.
Move the folder to where it was previously, probably in "Documents\RPG maker 2003".
Open RPG Maker and see the list of files.
